  fun ret s' => s'.assumed = #[] ∧ (∃ n, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ xs.length)

  wp_simp [f1]
  simp [e2, e3, hsz]
  generalize hj : i + 1#64 = j
  have hj1 : j.toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [← hj, BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  have hjn0 : 0 ≤ j.toInt := by omega
  have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hjn0

    wp_step prog_f1 [f1] as q
    simp [e1, hsz, ha]
    refine ⟨?_, c, rfl, hc0, ?_⟩
    · simpa using ha
    · omega

    dsimp only
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hjn0 hc
    have hjx : j.toNat < xs.length := by omega

    cases hx : (0#64).slt xs[j.toNat]

      refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz]; exact e0, by simp [hsz]; exact e3, ha, hh, c, j, by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, hc0, by omega⟩

        rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega

have hm1 : (18446744073709551615#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = -1 := by first | decide | rfl | simp
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f1
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f1 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f1]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f1 (cpInv xs xs_ref xs_len) (cp_step orc hv xs xs_ref xs_len h_xs_ref h_xs_len)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, h_assumed, h_xs, 0#64, 18446744073709551615#64, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> omega
